name: Himenomiya Shiori
source:
What an outrageous personality. Shiori has been sheltered by her rich parents all her life, so she acts very childish and innocent. However, this absence of shame means she doesn't hesitate to speak openly about her favorite hobby: masturbation. She's looking forward to expanding her sexual horizons with the [url=https://vndb.org/c60294]new guy[/url] in town...
